frontier.behavior: Stop before call; record kill mode and all object changes. No replacement callback, cleanup, drops or death side effect is executed by this suite.

limits: Full respawn placement/resetMoves=1 requires terrain/socket/portal and larger reset-state integration, not covered.
Death input clips use synthetic legacy duration headers and exact PC model/action pointer layout.
Finite scalar fixtures only; pathological NaNs or invalid pointer state are outside contract.
